lessons.title: Welcome to AI Concepts
lessons.description: A warm introduction to the course, outlining what learners will achieve, including a basic understanding of AI, its applications, and ethical considerations in a beginner-friendly way.

es.description: Obtén una visión general de este curso y descubre lo que aprenderás sobre la IA, sus aplicaciones y desafíos éticos.

en.description: Get an overview of this course and discover what you will learn about AI, its applications, and ethical challenges.

lessons.title: What is Artificial Intelligence
lessons.description: Explore the definition of AI, its history, and core principles. Understand how AI mimics human intelligence and its significance in today’s world through simple examples.

es.description: Explora la definición de inteligencia artificial, su historia, principios clave y ejemplos cotidianos para comprender cómo imita la inteligencia humana.

en.description: Learn the definition of artificial intelligence, its history, core principles, and everyday examples to understand how it mimics human intelligence.

lessons.title: Usages of AI
lessons.description: Learn how AI is used in various sectors like healthcare, education, and entertainment. Discover practical examples of AI tools and systems that impact daily routines and industries.

es.description: Explora cómo la IA transforma la salud, la educación, el entretenimiento y la vida diaria con ejemplos prácticos y herramientas reales.

en.description: Explore how AI is used in healthcare, education, entertainment, and everyday life through practical examples and real-world tools.

lessons.title: What are AI Models
lessons.description: Understand the concept of AI models, how they are trained, and their role in AI systems. Explore different types of models and their purposes in solving problems.

es.description: Aprende qué son los modelos de IA, cómo se entrenan con datos y los distintos tipos que existen para resolver problemas reales.

en.description: Learn what AI models are, how they are trained from data, and explore the different types used to solve real-world problems.

lessons.title: Applications of AI in Industries
lessons.description: Dive into specific applications of AI across industries such as automotive, finance, and retail. See how AI drives innovation, efficiency, and decision-making in real-world business scenarios.

lessons.title: Benefits of AI in Everyday Life
lessons.description: Discover how AI improves daily life through tools like virtual assistants, recommendation systems, and smart devices. Learn about AI’s role in enhancing convenience and productivity.

es.description: Descubre cómo los asistentes virtuales, los sistemas de recomendación y los dispositivos inteligentes facilitan tu día a día.

en.description: Explore how virtual assistants, recommendation systems, and smart devices make your daily tasks easier and more efficient.

lessons.title: Early Concepts Quiz
lessons.description: Test your understanding of basic AI concepts, models, and applications covered so far. This quiz includes questions on definitions, usages, and industry examples to reinforce learning.

es.description: Responde preguntas sobre los conceptos básicos de inteligencia artificial para reforzar lo aprendido en las lecciones anteriores.

en.description: Test your understanding of core AI concepts by answering a series of review questions covering definitions, uses, models, and applications.

lessons.title: Key Players in the AI Industry
lessons.description: Identify major companies and organizations shaping the AI landscape. Learn about their contributions, innovations, and how they influence the development and adoption of AI technologies globally.

es.description: Explora las principales empresas y organizaciones que impulsan la IA, como Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Apple, Meta y otras.

en.description: Explore the major companies and organizations shaping AI, including Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Apple, Meta, and others.

lessons.title: Future Trends in AI
lessons.description: Explore emerging trends in AI, such as advancements in automation, personalized AI, and sustainability. Understand how these trends might shape the future of technology and society over time.

es.description: Explora tres tendencias clave en IA: automatización, personalización y sostenibilidad. Descubre cómo transformarán el trabajo, la vida y el planeta.

en.description: Explore three key AI trends: automation, personalization, and sustainability. Learn how they will reshape work, life, and the planet.

lessons.title: Challenges in AI
lessons.description: Examine the technical and societal challenges of AI, including data privacy, bias in algorithms, and job displacement. Understand the complexities and risks associated with AI deployment in various contexts.

lessons.title: Ethical Considerations of AI
lessons.description: Delve into the ethical dilemmas of AI, such as fairness, accountability, and transparency. Learn about the importance of responsible AI development and the impact on trust and societal values.

lessons.title: Final Knowledge Check
lessons.description: Assess your grasp of intermediate AI topics like key players, future trends, and challenges. This quiz ensures retention of concepts before moving to final reflections and takeaways.

es.description: Pon a prueba tu comprensión de los conceptos clave de IA con este cuestionario final que cubre modelos, aplicaciones, desafíos y ética.

en.description: Test your knowledge of AI concepts with this final quiz covering models, applications, challenges, and ethical considerations.

courseInfo.description: Embark on a beginner-friendly journey into the world of Artificial Intelligence with this comprehensive course. Designed for those new to AI, this 30-minute exploration covers the fundamental concepts, including what AI is, its core principles, and how it’s applied across various industries. You’ll learn about AI models, their types, and real-world benefits in everyday life. Discover key players shaping the AI landscape, future trends, and the ethical challenges that come with this technology. Through engaging lessons and quizzes, build a solid foundation in AI concepts and understand its transformative impact on society and technology.
